name: Force Ward
body:
School conjuration (creation) [force]; Level bard 0, bloodrager 0, magus 0, sorcerer/wizard 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range self
Target you
Duration 1 round

You create a minor force barrier around yourself. Until the end of your next turn, you gain DR 1/-.
